info.name: Gets a list of all Profiles in a compartment

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the compartment that contains the resources to list. This filter returns only resources contained within the specified compartment.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return resources that match the given display names.

params.name: displayNameContains
params.description: A filter to return resources that may partially match the given display name.

params.name: profileType
params.description: A filter to return registration profiles that match the given profile type.

params.name: profileId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the registration profile. A filter used to return the specified profile.

params.name: osFamily
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the given operating system family.

params.name: archType
params.description: A filter to return only profiles that match the given archType.

params.name: registrationType
params.description: A filter to return profiles that match the given instance type.

params.name: isDefaultProfile
params.description: A filter to return only default profiles.

params.name: isServiceProvidedProfile
params.description: A filter to return only service-provided profiles.

params.name: managementStation
params.description:
A filter to return resources that are associated with the specified management 
station [OCIDs](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm).

params.name: managementStationNotEqualTo
params.description:
A filter to return resources that aren't associated with the specified management 
station [OCIDs](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm).

params.name: profileVersion
params.description: The version of the registration profile.

params.name: vendorName
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the given vendor name.

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a paginated "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `50`

params.name: page
params.description:
For list pagination. The value of the `opc-next-page` response header from the previous "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `3`

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: A filter to return only registration profiles in the given state.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. 
Default order for timeCreated is descending. 
Default order for displayName is ascending.

items.docs:
Lists registration profiles that match the specified compartment or profile OCID. Filter the list against a 
variety of criteria including but not limited to its name, status, vendor name, and architecture type.
Creates a registration profile. A profile defines the content applied to the instance when registering it with the service.
